blocks.title: Linear regression
blocks.text: Linear regression models the relationship between two variables to predict one from the other: Y = b0 + b1 X + error, where Y is the dependent variable, X the independent variable, b0 the intercept (Y when X = 0), b1 the slope (change in Y per unit of X) and the error term the gap between predicted and actual values.

blocks.caption: Fruit stall: customers and daily earnings

blocks.text: Every 5 extra customers add 200 rupees, so the slope b1 = 200 / 5 = 40 rupees per customer. Using 10 customers and 500 rupees: 500 = b0 + 40 x 10, so b0 = 100, the base earnings with no customers. The model is earnings = 100 + 40 x customers. For 22 customers it predicts 100 + 880 = 980 rupees. On day 6, 28 customers gave 1,250 rupees while the model predicted 100 + 1,120 = 1,220; the error is 30 rupees (actual minus predicted), showing real data vary.
